conversations.topic: New phone with case and screen protector

speakers.speaker: A
speakers.summary: Welcoming and unhurried; answers every question and accepts the refusal without comment.

speakers.speaker: B
speakers.summary: Clear about budget and priorities, warms up when the camera is mentioned, pays without hesitation.

customer_requested: A phone around 3,000 SAR with a good camera and battery.

upsell_attempts.quote: بالمناسبة، الغطاء مع واقي الشاشة الاثنين بـ 129 ريال بدل 180، تبي أضيفهم لك؟
upsell_attempts.offered_item: Case and screen protector for 129 SAR

upsell_attempts.quote: وفيه كمان حماية الشاشة المكسورة لمدة سنة بـ 199 ريال، إذا حاب.

excluded_candidates: أبشر. عندي جهازين مناسبين: هذا بـ 2,899 ريال، كاميرا 50 ميجا وبطارية تكفي يومين، وهذا بـ 3,199 أغلى شوي. -> Presents two phones inside the customer's stated budget; this answers the request.
أكيد، ضمان سنتين من الوكيل. Excellent choice, الكاميرا فيه ممتازة بالليل. -> Answers the warranty question with the standard manufacturer warranty.
upsell.pushy_reason: The broken-screen protection was offered once; after the customer said no, the salesperson moved straight to payment.
upsell.summary: The salesperson matched a phone to the customer's budget, then offered a case and screen-protector bundle (accepted) and optional screen-damage cover (declined, not repeated). Total 3,028 SAR.
upsell.greeting_quote: السلام عليكم، حياك الله. أقدر أخدمك بشيء؟
upsell.coaching_feedback: You asked about budget and priorities first, then offered add-ons that matched a new phone. Keep doing this: one bundle, one optional cover, and stop at the first no.

speakers.speaker: C
speakers.summary: Pleasant, buys the first item shown.

customer_requested: A fast charger for an older phone.
excluded_candidates: عندي شاحن 45 واط بـ 89 ريال، يشتغل مع كل الأجهزة. -> Quotes the charger the customer asked for.
خذ الشاحن هذا وكيبل تايب سي، المجموع 89 ريال بس الشاحن، الكيبل معاه. -> Confirms the cable is included; not an extra purchase.
upsell.pushy_reason: No offer was repeated after a customer said no.
upsell.summary: No upsell. The customer said he was travelling next week, which was a natural opening for a power bank, but the salesperson only sold the charger.
upsell.coaching_feedback: When the customer said he was travelling, that was the moment for one light suggestion, such as a 10,000 mAh power bank, then accept the answer. Missed chance, not a failing.

speakers.speaker: A
speakers.summary: Patient and honest about the cheaper option.

speakers.speaker: D
speakers.summary: Careful with money but trusts the advice; leaves satisfied.

customer_requested: A university laptop for presentations and research.

upsell_attempts.quote: ضمان سنتين. ولو حابين، عندنا حقيبة لابتوب مع ماوس لاسلكي بـ 149 ريال.
upsell_attempts.offered_item: Laptop bag with wireless mouse for 149 SAR

excluded_candidates: تمام. للجامعة أنصحك بهذا، 16 جيجا رام و512 تخزين، السعر 3,499 ريال. -> Recommends one suitable laptop; no upgrade beyond what the use needs.
فيه نسخة 8 جيجا بـ 2,799 ريال، بس ما أنصحك فيها لأنها تبطأ مع البرامج الثقيلة. الخيار لك. -> Gives the cheaper option and explains the trade-off honestly.
upsell.pushy_reason: One accessory offer, accepted refusal immediately.
upsell.summary: The salesperson recommended the right laptop for a student, was honest about the cheaper model, made one optional accessory offer and stopped when the customer said she already had a bag.
upsell.greeting_quote: Good evening, welcome. كيف أقدر أساعدك؟
upsell.coaching_feedback: Strong consultative sale. Honest about the trade-off, which builds trust. Next time ask what the student already owns before offering the bag.
